author: Summer Phoenix l Gene Keys Business Mentor
title: Being Sexy Does Not Equal Lust
one_liner: Expressing sexuality and sensuality is not the same as inviting or embodying lust.
key_points: Being sexy is a form of self-expression, not an invitation for lust
Embodiment and sensuality can exist separately from lustful intent
Reclaiming the right to feel attractive without shame or misinterpretation
